# Adventure Quest

An original retro adventure-menu theme with pixel lettering, green and gold framed panels, and a generated forest-map backdrop. Dark mode uses near-black panels; light mode uses parchment colors.

Defaults: Dual pane with sections, right sidebar open, Plasma off. Fonts and background are bundled for offline use. Visual colors and surface opacity remain editable. Edit theme creates a copy that can revert to the built-in defaults.

The background was generated for this theme, not extracted from the reference game. VT323 is distributed under the SIL Open Font License; see LICENSE. Theme styling and original artwork are supplied under CC0.

Build the portable package with `node docs/themes/build-example.mjs 8-bit-adventure`.
